changelog: **Webhook event picker grouped by family (#1998, 9/n):** the admin integrations screen (new and edit forms) groups the subscribable events under Applications & pipeline, Mentorships, Progress & activity, Meetings, Interviews and Hiring & offers instead of one wall of checkboxes. The family is decided by `webhookEventFamily()` (`src/lib/webhookEventFamilies.ts`, pure); a browserless spec fails if a public event falls into "other". EN/TR/DE labels, MARKETING overlay for the mentorship family.

en: The webhook event list on the integrations screen is now grouped by topic.
tr: Entegrasyonlar ekranındaki webhook olay listesi artık konuya göre gruplanıyor.
de: Die Webhook-Ereignisliste auf der Integrationsseite ist jetzt nach Themen gruppiert.
